description: This file defines the Aws\SesV2\SesV2Client class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) V2 API using the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides method signatures for various SES operations, marked with @method annotations, indicating its use as a service client.

classes.name: SesV2Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS SES V2 service, extending AwsClient and providing method signatures for SES operations.
